info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Agents-v4-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings by Agent API provides access to a comprehensive list of real estate listings associated with specific agents. This API enables real estate professionals and developers to retrieve detailed property information, including listing status, pricing, and agent details. Typical consumers of this API include real estate platforms, market analysts, and application developers looking to incorporate property data into their services. It serves as a critical resource for facilitating informed decision-making in real estate transactions.

get.summary: Retrieve listings for a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves a list of real estate listings associated with a particular agent. It allows users to view all properties handled by the agent, providing essential details for potential buyers.
